name: Aldous Vane
desire: see his father's boat launched on the morning tide, today, in front of the men who knew him
need: to let his father be finished without pretending the loss away
values: keeping his word to the men he invited
the boat as proof his father's years meant something
fears: that the boat was a waste of the years his father gave it
standing in front of Tom's friends with nothing to show
contradictions: came to a surveyor he trusts, then fights every true thing she tells him
beliefs: his father built boats for fifty years and his last one will float
fresh paint means a sound boat
letting the launch go means letting his father go
knowledge: that the tide is right this morning
that his father painted the hull the spring before he got sick
that Tom's friends are coming to the slip
constraints: grief he cannot say out loud
the men are already on their way

lexicon: his father's phrases repeated as if quoting scripture
syntax: statements where a question would cost him
